issues.description: The Person deletion API is inconsistent across artifacts: the problem statement and the template/service expect deletion by UUID (DELETE /persons/{personId} and PersonService.deletePerson(UUID)), but the solution's PersonService declares deletePerson(Person) while the solution's PersonResource still calls personService.deletePerson(personId) (passing a UUID). This mismatch (Person vs UUID) will cause compilation errors and blocks correct implementation or testing of the delete endpoint.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the PersonService.deletePerson API consistent with the endpoint and template by changing the solution's PersonService.deletePerson(Person) to deletePerson(UUID personId) and implement the removal using the UUID (e.g. removeIf(p -> p.getId().equals(personId))). Ensure PersonResource and any callers pass the UUID accordingly.
